response.overview: The 2026 NXT TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event (PLE) and television special produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It is WWE's first NXT TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs and the 13th TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs overall. It will take place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida. It will be simulcast on The CW's linear channel and ESPN Unlimited in the United States, marking the first TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs to broadcast on both services.
response.title: NXT TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs 2026
